messages:
Elan: Quick design check: compact version strip in Rollouts — keyboard order and SR announcements are flaky. Anyone else see this? Marta: Yep. Tab lands on the scrubber container and VoiceOver says 'group' only; the active dot isn't announced. Tyler: We've used role=slider historically, but SR users prefer discrete controls. Recommend each version be a button with aria-pressed=true for active. Marta: Buttons + an aria-live announcer that says 'Selected version v2.1.0, released Mar 2' on focus change. Also include canary state in the label when applicable. Asha (PM): Copy nit: the rollback button reads just "Rollback". Make it explicit: "Rollback to v2.1.0" and show a truncated changelog on hover. Elan: For compact view, show a 1-line changelog + a "View details" link so rollback isn't blind. Tyler: Keyboard ergonomics: add a visually-hidden "Skip to latest" link so users don't tab through many versions. Example: Skip to latest version. Marta: Visual contrast: tiny timeline dots are low contrast. accessibility-bot? accessibility-bot: Scan: dot color (#6b6b6b) on white yields 2.1:1 for small targets. Recommend using brand accent (#0057d7) or increase effective target to 24px with hidden hit area and add focus ring. Tyler: We'll keep visual compactness but add a 24px hit target and clear focus outline. Also add aria-labels like 'live canary, 5% traffic' for allocation pills. Marta: Add inline pause/resume for canaries with a modal: title 'Pause canary?', body explaining effect, buttons 'Pause' (destructive) and 'Cancel'. Follow platform button ordering. Asha (PM): Change compact term "Deployed" -> "Released" per ops request. Update docs. Tyler: Quick markup sketch for eng: ```html
Skip to latest version
``` Elan: Nice. accessibility-bot: validate patterns? accessibility-bot: OK. Ensure aria-live updates are debounced (~300ms), test NVDA+Chrome and VoiceOver. Confirm aria-pressed behavior across browsers. Elan: Actions: Tyler -> PR with markup + CSS sketch; Marta -> docs/copy update; Asha -> add a11y check to release checklist. Tyler aiming PR by EOD. Tyler: On it. PR by EOD with testing notes. Elan: Closing once PR is open. :thumbsup:
